items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Charlie Creath? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. I caught him at a party, you know. I never could figure out where he was... He was just... The only one that I got to really like was Baby James.

ctx.x: that Southern trumpet playing! The only one who was a little different was Dewey Jackson. Then there was Zutty's brother, or brother-in-law...

Yeah. I caught him at a party, you know. I never could figure out where he was... Well, maybe he might have been something, I don't know. He was just... The only one that I got to really like was Baby James. This cat had a nice sound and he played those things of Louis nice, you know. I don't know whatever happened to him.
